title: Xilly's Afterdiamond
description: random story mod, adds a colossal amount of content. 40 hours of gameplay
body:

SOME TIPS

You need to craft Amelia Void Medal to reach end of this mod. To do this, you need to pass amelia dimension, for activate amelia altar you need "Is This Amelia?" tool  
Press P to see tips, other keybinds you can see in key settings  
You need to understand artefacts by putting it in random slots in artefact menu. To switch artefacts, you need to press key R (i dont remember really). Artefacts its musthave  
not very compatible with other mods, may cause crash with optifine in multiplayer (host dont crashing, but players do)
